compound identifying the mātṛkā that begins with the glorious seed-syllable

items.question: Which form of the letter-matrix is designated as the fifth nyāsa in this sequence?
premises: A sequence of letter placements is being enumerated in the preceding verses.
The fifth placement in this sequence is explicitly named.
This fifth placement is identified as the mātṛkā beginning with the glorious seed-syllable.
items.inference: The fifth nyāsa is the letter-matrix that begins with the glorious seed-syllable.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the glorious seed-syllable is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: The fifth nyāsa is declared to be the mātṛkā beginning with the glorious seed-syllable.
